workspace = "../../../../../.."
name = "semio-framework-io-sqlite-snapshot"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version.workspace = true
description = "Dependency-free relational SQLite engine for handcrafted artifact snapshot schemas"

[package.metadata.semio]
role = "framework"
id = "io-sqlite-snapshot"

[lints]
workspace = true

[lib]

[[bin]]

[dev-dependencies]
semio-framework-value.workspace = true
